profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS and identified by CIK 0000883241. On its website the company describes itself as delivering comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. Its site presents the business around EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification.

The site also carries a notice that visitors are interacting with an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about Synopsys, including its products and services, which the notice states may be incorrect or incomplete. The notice says the terms of any applicable agreements supersede information the chatbot provides, that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool, and that using the chatbot is agreement to that data processing.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281 cases.
